title: Rahab and the Spies

questions.question: How many spies did Joshua send to Jericho?
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:1 (ESV): "And Joshua the son of Nun sent two men secretly from Shittim as spies..."

questions.question: Whose house did the spies enter?
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:1 (ESV): "...And they went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab..."

questions.question: Where did Rahab hide the spies?
options: On the roof, under stalks of flax
questions.correctAnswer: On the roof, under stalks of flax
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:6 (ESV): "But she had brought them up to the roof and hid them with the stalks of flax..."

questions.question: What sign was Rahab to use to save her family?
options: A scarlet cord tied in the window
questions.correctAnswer: A scarlet cord tied in the window
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:18 (ESV): "Behold, when we come into the land, you shall tie this scarlet cord in the window..."

questions.question: What did the spies report to Joshua upon their return?
options: Truly the Lord has given all the land into our hands
The people are strong and the cities are fortified
questions.correctAnswer: Truly the Lord has given all the land into our hands
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:24 (ESV): "Truly the Lord has given all the land into our hands. And also, all the inhabitants of the land melt away because of us."

questions.question: Where did the king's men pursue the spies?
options: As far as the fords of the Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: As far as the fords of the Jordan
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:7 (ESV): "So the men pursued after them on the way to the Jordan as far as the fords."

questions.question: What reason did Rahab give for hiding the spies?
options: She knew the Lord had given them the land and the fear of them had fallen upon the city
questions.correctAnswer: She knew the Lord had given them the land and the fear of them had fallen upon the city
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:9 (ESV): "I know that the Lord has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us..."

questions.question: What two events had the people of Jericho heard about?
options: The drying up of the Red Sea and the destruction of Sihon and Og
The plagues of Egypt and the manna
The giving of the Law and the golden calf
The water from the rock and the quail
questions.correctAnswer: The drying up of the Red Sea and the destruction of Sihon and Og
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:10 (ESV): "For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea... and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites... Sihon and Og..."

questions.question: How did Rahab let the spies down?
options: By a rope through the window
questions.correctAnswer: By a rope through the window
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:15 (ESV): "Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was built into the city wall..."

questions.question: Where did the spies hide after escaping?
options: In the hills for three days
questions.correctAnswer: In the hills for three days
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:22 (ESV): "They departed and went into the hills and remained there three days until the pursuers returned..."

questions.question: What condition did the spies place on the oath?
options: If Rahab told their business, they would be guiltless
If the cord was not red
questions.correctAnswer: If Rahab told their business, they would be guiltless
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:14, 20 (ESV): "But if you tell this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless with respect to your oath..."

questions.question: Which family members was Rahab trying to save?
options: Father, mother, brothers, sisters, and all who belonged to them
questions.correctAnswer: Father, mother, brothers, sisters, and all who belonged to them
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:13 (ESV): "that you will save alive my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them..."

questions.question: At what time did Rahab say the men left?
options: At the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark
questions.correctAnswer: At the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:5 (ESV): "And when the gate was about to be shut at dark, the men went out."

questions.question: What was Sihon and Og's fate described as ("devoted to...")?
What specific emotion happened to the people of the land?
options: Their hearts melted and there was no spirit left in any man
questions.correctAnswer: Their hearts melted and there was no spirit left in any man
questions.explanation: Joshua 2:11 (ESV): "And as soon as we heard it, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in any man because of you..."

key_verse_text: And as soon as we heard it, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in any man because of you, for the LORD your God, he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath. (ESV)
